messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-12-05, the pager for the reporting service rings the Ember team instead of the Dune team. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. [valid 2026-04-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13-2]
- The reporting service is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-12-05, having moved from the Dune team. [decision; valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
    earlier: The reporting service is owned by the Dune team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-12-05; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- As of 2025-06-24, the reporting service still relies on the ledger service. [valid 2025-06-24 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-06-24]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer depends on the ledger service. [valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- As of 2026-04-01, the pager for the indexer rings the Boreal team, not the Atlas team. [valid 2026-04-01 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer]
- As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team instead of the Boreal team. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
- As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service switched its data source from the ledger service to the bus because nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [decision; valid 2025-09-23 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-23]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team is taking over the event bus from the Boreal team. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is the primary on-call for the Ember team, taking over from Diego. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Diego is the primary on-call for the Ember team. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- As of 2026-05-29, Oskar is on the Ember team on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-01-15, Oskar is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-01-15 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-15]
- The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-26 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-26]
- Priya Raman holds the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team as of 2025-07-30. [valid 2025-07-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-30]
    earlier: Tomasz has the first on-call rotation for the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-30; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-09]
- The billing API is owned by the Ember team as of 2026-01-12, having moved from the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
- As of 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings Cinder instead of the Atlas team. [valid 2025-10-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-13-ledger]
- On 2026-04-14 the Dune team noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-14 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-14-2]
- As of 2026-05-29, Diego is off the Ember team on-call rotation. [valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, having moved from the Ember team. [valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-05-15-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Ember team as of 2025-03-03. [valid 2025-03-03 to 2025-05-15; recorded by handover/2025-03-03-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-3]
- As of 2025-12-25, the Atlas team is located on the second floor. [valid 2025-12-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-12-25]
- As of 2026-05-29, the Ember team's pager contact is Oskar, not Diego. [constraint; valid 2026-05-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-29]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team's pager contact is Diego, not Oskar, for this cycle. [constraint; valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-05-29; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-13]
    earlier: As of 2026-03-02, the Ember team reminded everyone to page Oskar, not Diego, for anything this cycle. [constraint; valid 2026-03-02 to 2026-04-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-02]

Question: As of now, which team is responsible for reporting?
